QuestInfo.name: Correcting the Past 1: Good Bye Janitor
QuestInfo.0: Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to prevent the collection of Mainboards required to build a Time Machine.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Deep Sea in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat the #b#o9420069#s#k that are collecting Mainboards.
QuestInfo.2: You prevented the collection of Mainboards, which are required to build a Time Machine.

0.0: Do you remember what happened in the Deep Sea? You gathered Mainboards from the crashed spaceships.
0.1: I will send you to the Deep Sea of the past using a black whole activation device. You will be fighting against divers like yourself from the past.
0.2: Defeat as many divers as you can so that the Mainboards won't be gathered.\n\rThe diving suits should prevent the people inside from getting hurt.

yes.0: The Black Hole has been activated. Now, hurry!

no.0: You are the only one who can fix the past...

1.0: You're back! Thanks to your efforts, it seems many Maplers were able to gather the necessary Mainboards to build their Time Machines. Whew!

yes.0: But it's not over yet. We'll need your help again tomorrow!

default.0: You couldn't fix the past?! Try again!
